rationale: Each event toggles src_toggle, but the destination only delays the synchronised level (event_pulse <= t2). There is no edge detector, so it never emits the required one-cycle pulse per transition. The first event leaves the output stuck high and the next one clears it.
caveats: CDC-014 (no edge detector) is specified as WARNING Unresolved, so a hit is an unresolved-bad outcome, not established detection. Report it against the unresolved-bad budget.
CDC-013(a) will probably also fire on the 10 ns to 14 ns ratio. The contract guarantees four dst periods between toggles, so CDC-013 is not defect-specific here and is not in expected_rules.

Raw rst_n asynchronously resets every register with no local release synchroniser and no SDC reset exception; RDC-003 (WARNING Unresolved), RDC-002 (WARNING Unresolved) and RDC-013 (physical obligation) are expected if RDC rules run. The contract states only asynchronous assertion, so this is a whole-IP premise gap, not a defect of the labelled crossing.
